status: provisional pre-production contract (not run at scale). It changes the target population of v2: only windows with a direct FREE-FREE response interface are eligible. kappa, quotas, caps and the coverage design are v2's and are NOT yet re-validated for the v3 population (docs/SAMPLING_IMPACT_V3.md; H20 canary still required)
supersedes: rind3d-100k-contract-v2 (window rule 'mixed'; kept unchanged for regression and reproducibility)

source_count.draw: k = 1 + #{i < 3 : u >= cumsum(kappa)[i]}, u = keyed_rng(seed, slot, 56000).random(); independent of the geometry, the sources and the attempt
source_count.status: provisional default pending the canary (>= 50% K = 4 scenes; J_COMPLEXITY_COVERAGE.md)

source_rule.prior: uniform on D(G) = open cube, outside the closed solid, certified clearance > 2^-26

selection.target: T*_v3: natural multi-source worlds; natural admissible windows (origin uniform on {0..N-L}^3, admissible iff no source in the closed box, FREE > 0 and m >= 1 under the direct-interface rule); every channel with a direct interface is one example

natural.acceptance: every admissible proposal (c = 1); no m-dependent thinning

coverage.fallback: natural (the slot is filled from the natural stream and recorded as natural_fallback)
coverage.streams: separate keyed origin / U streams (58000 + L, 59000 + L); logically distinct from the natural stream

selection.rate_stream: R natural proposals per side with EXACT v3 m for every proposal: P_A_hat = rate_A / rate_n, Lambda_cov_hat = sum_m c(m) rate_m / rate_n; the v2 rule of the same proposals is recorded too (rate_A_mixed, rate_m_mixed), diagnostic only
selection.weights: T* balance heuristic per natural proposal: w(m) = 1 / sum_s n_s c_s(m) / Lambda_s (natural: c = 1, Lambda = P_A; coverage: c(m), Lambda_cov)

planning.rule: declared: the plan of a slot depends only on (seed, slot); no barrier between epochs

exclusion: every source outside every accepted closed window box [o/N, (o+L)/N]^3
informative: see eligibility.definition (direct FREE-FREE response interface); v2's 'mixed' mask of each stored window is kept as windows.mixed_mask
splits: sha256(scene_id) mod 100: < 80 train, < 90 val, else test

labels.reference_engine: tau-pencil tpe-b4/p2-cpu+g2-gpu-pass-v3.1 (rind3d_posterior.label_window): exact references and regression

fastlabel.n_tasks_rule: upper bound 100000 scenes x 12 windows x 4 channels, so the union bound over the campaign holds for any realised label count

labels.target: Uniform(F_W^j) over D(G) minus the closed window box, cell masses on the 128^3 grid

statuses.certified: deterministic tv_bound <= 0.05 (single-cell support or exact path)
statuses.certified_stat: tv_bound = eps = 0.05 with P(false certificate) <= family_delta / n_tasks per label; certificate in the label meta

labels.uninformative_slots: kept (responses stored), status not_computed: every channel without a direct interface, including SOLID-separated mixed channels

storage.scene_file: scenes/<slot//1000:04d>/<slot:06d>.npz (one atomic container per scene; tmp, fsync, rename, directory fsync)
storage.labels: append-only journals labels/journal/*.r3lj, consolidated to labels/scenes/<shard>/<slot:06d>.labels.npz with a sha256 record in labels/consolidated.jsonl
storage.responses: per (window, source) packed bits (Z,Y,X), zstd; SOLID once per window

eligibility.definition: channel j of window W is informative iff W contains two 6-adjacent receivers u, v (|u - v|_1 = 1 voxel) that are both FREE and have different binary responses R_j(u) != R_j(v); m(W) = number of informative channels
excluded: windows whose only active/inactive contacts pass through SOLID (SOLID-separated mixed channels)
eligibility.note: a research-scope choice for the primary population, not a claim that the excluded configurations are physically invalid; historical OOD diagnostic sets are unchanged
eligibility.decision: exact (rind3d_100k.local_eval.evaluate_proposal_interface): constructive bisection proofs, the exact all-active hull certificate and exact 64^3 tile scans including edges across tile faces; screening changes cost, never a decision
eligibility.fallback: none: a proposal is accepted only if it is eligible; an unfilled side rejects the scene attempt (quota_unfilled) as in v2

families_note: the nine historical convex-polyhedral families (round robin slot % 9, as in v2). Curved families (spheres) are physical-research only until a certified posterior labeller supports them; they are not part of T*_v3; thin bodies (all of thin_slabs, 25% of occluder_clusters) follow geometry.thin_law
terminology: driver source (legacy: source / light); response-active / response-inactive receiver (legacy keys: lit / dark); response interface (legacy: lit/dark boundary). Serialized keys keep their legacy names

geometry.thin_law: log2(half thickness) ~ U(log2(T_min / (2 N)), -5): the v0.1 law 2^U(-20, -5) conditioned on full thickness >= T_min voxels; same single uniform, so every other draw equals v0.1's for the same (seed, slot, attempt)
geometry.thin_check: exact: the voxel-centre sampling of every thin slab (receivers inside the closed slab) is nonempty and 6-connected; the same canonical body defines SOLID and visibility; nothing is repaired on the voxel side
geometry.on_invalid: geometry proposal failure: the scene attempt is rejected (reason thin_slab_invalid) and retried under max_attempts
geometry.why: observable, spatially coherent thin occluders (docs/THIN_SLABS_V3.md); not intended to remove difficult shadow geometry
